audit.why: Yasuo 1-2, Skill at 3 and 4-5, Yi at 6 and first item, Yasuo at 2+ items. phases[].side and win[] agree row for row with the packet chart.
Level 6 Highlander then first on-hit item for you, second crit item for him — that is exactly where the chart flips at index 6.
audit.corrected: No spike restructuring; Steel Tempest's 4s cooldown added so the poke window is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1], spikes[2] and late all tell you to fight 'after his Sweeping Blade dash is on cooldown'.
audit.why: Sweeping Blade has a 0.5s-to-0.1s cooldown — it is never meaningfully down. Riot's own limit is different: it cannot be re-cast on the SAME enemy for a few seconds, and it needs a unit to dash through at all. Waiting for a cooldown that does not exist means never taking the fight; the real trigger is the moment he dashes through you, or a wave state with nothing left to dash through.
audit.corrected: All three re-keyed to the same-target lockout and the lack of dash targets.
sources: enemyKit.E cd 0.5/0.4/0.3/0.2/0.1 and 'Cannot be re-cast on the same enemy for a few seconds'

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns calls Wind Wall a 26s cooldown and treats it as the tracked ability.
audit.why: Wind Wall is 25/23/21/19/17. More importantly the page itself says it blocks nothing of yours — the cooldown that actually decides the lane is Steel Tempest at 4s, since the Q3 knockup is the only thing that catches you after Alpha Strike.
audit.corrected: Real numbers written in and the tracking priority moved to Steel Tempest stacks.

edits.before: Track his Windwall (W) — it's a 26s cooldown that blocks nothing of mine since I'm melee on-hit, so its real value to me is knowing when it's DOWN to all-in; and track his flow stacks/Q3, since that knockup is the only thing that catches me after Alpha Strike.
edits.after: Track his Wind Wall (W) — 25s at rank 1 — but it blocks nothing of mine since I am melee, so it is only a fight-timing tell. Track Steel Tempest stacks instead: the Q3 knockup, off a 4s cooldown, is the one thing that catches me after Alpha Strike.

edits.after: With Kraken/BOTRK your DPS burns his Flow shield faster than he can burst you; he cannot re-dash the same target, so commit right after he dashes onto you.
